## Grace That Holds

### 1. Grace meets us where we are

The Word became flesh and **made his dwelling among us**. God did not wait for us to climb up to him.

- Grace is unearned
- Grace is unlimited
- Grace is unconditional

### 2. Grace does not leave us there

> From his fullness we have all received, grace upon grace.

### 3. Grace holds when everything else lets go

Read *Romans 8:38-39*.
